Agent Name: Financial_Expert
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: They calculated the revenue-to-rent ratio without properly cleaning the dataset. Specifically, they only dropped rows with missing Name, which left non-vendor section headers like “Zone 2” (and likely other intra-table headers/summaries) in the data, and did not restrict to rows with valid numeric Revenue/Rent and a real vendor Type. This flawed filtering risks selecting a non-vendor row or miscomputing ratios, leading to the wrong vendor/type instead of the correct “Finance.”
